notes: r300. Spice-aisle jar; rubs/brines/marinades excluded.

notes: r300. 100% wild rice only; long-grain-and-wild BLENDS excluded (a blend is mostly white rice and would undercut the real per-oz).

name: Pigeon Peas / Gandules (canned)
notes: r300. Goya/La Preferida green gandules. NEEDS relax_global \bcanned\b; dried gandules excluded (different price class).

name: Aji Amarillo Paste
notes: r300. Goya/Inca's jar; thin coverage expected (achiote-paste class, n=1).

name: Rye Bread (loaf)
notes: r300. Distinct variety at 2-3x the white-loaf price (red-onion variety precedent); reciprocal exclude added to bread.
